# Pleats — Design & Implementation Tasks

## Overview

Recreation of ColorLib Bootstrap Accordion V05 as an elegant, interactive React component showcase named **Pleats**.

## Section Structure (1:1 with preview)

1. **Header / Hero Section**: Centered title ("Pleats Interactive Showcase")
2. **Accordion Container (`.myaccordion`)**:
   - Card 1: **Manage** (Icons: Settings/Account, Sub-items: Account, Settings, Profile)
   - Card 2: **Location** (Icons: Map/Location, Sub-items: Regions, Headquarters, Warehouses)
   - Card 3: **Hobbies** (Icons: Heart/Star, Sub-items: Reading, Travel, Photography)
3. **Footer**: Component Dock branding and attribution (`https://www.componentdock.com/`).

## Fidelity Notes

- Use Lucide React icons matching ionicons from the original preview (User, MapPin, Compass).
- Smooth transition states for accordion expansion.
- Clean typography using Poppins font.
